operation.summary: A batch of Android Management API requests in one, each a whole request frisket cannot see.

operation.description: Lists EMM-managed enterprises. Only BASIC fields are returned.
Creates an enterprise. This is the last step in the enterprise signup flow. See also: SigninDetail

operation.summary: Permanently deletes an enterprise and all accounts and data associated with it.
operation.description: Permanently deletes an enterprise and all accounts and data associated with it. Warning: this will result in a cascaded deletion of all AM API devices associated with the deleted enterprise. Only available for EMM-managed enterprises.
Updates an enterprise. See also: SigninDetail

operation.summary: Lists devices for a given enterprise.
operation.description: Lists devices for a given enterprise. Deleted devices are not returned in the response.

Deletes a device. This operation attempts to wipe the device but this is not guaranteed to succeed if the device is offline for an extended period. Deleted devices do not show up in enterprises.devices.list calls and a 404 is returned from enterprises.devices.get.
Gets a device. Deleted devices will respond with a 404 error.

operation.summary: Lists operations that match the specified filter in the request.
operation.description: Lists operations that match the specified filter in the request. If the server doesn't support this method, it returns UNIMPLEMENTED.

operation.summary: Gets the latest state of a long-running operation.
operation.description: Gets the latest state of a long-running operation. Clients can use this method to poll the operation result at intervals as recommended by the API service.

operation.summary: Starts asynchronous cancellation on a long-running operation.
operation.description: Starts asynchronous cancellation on a long-running operation. The server makes a best effort to cancel the operation, but success is not guaranteed. If the server doesn't support this method, it returns google.rpc.Code.UNIMPLEMENTED. Clients can use Operations.GetOperation or other methods to check whether the cancellation succeeded or whether the operation completed despite cancellation. On successful cancellation, the operation is not deleted; instead, it becomes an operation with an Operation.error value with a google.rpc.Status.code of 1, corresponding to Code.CANCELLED.

operation.summary: Issues a command to a device.
operation.description: Issues a command to a device. The Operation resource returned contains a Command in its metadata field. Use the get operation method to get the status of the command.

operation.summary: Lists active, unexpired enrollment tokens for a given enterprise.
operation.description: Lists active, unexpired enrollment tokens for a given enterprise. The list items contain only a partial view of EnrollmentToken object. Only the following fields are populated: name, expirationTimestamp, allowPersonalUsage, value, qrCode. This method is meant to help manage active enrollment tokens lifecycle. For security reasons, it's recommended to delete active enrollment tokens as soon as they're not intended to be used anymore.

operation.summary: Creates an enrollment token for a given enterprise.
operation.description: Creates an enrollment token for a given enterprise. It's up to the caller's responsibility to manage the lifecycle of newly created tokens and deleting them when they're not intended to be used anymore.
Deletes an enrollment token. This operation invalidates the token, preventing its future use.

operation.summary: Gets an active, unexpired enrollment token.
operation.description: Gets an active, unexpired enrollment token. A partial view of the enrollment token is returned. Only the following fields are populated: name, expirationTimestamp, allowPersonalUsage, value, qrCode. This method is meant to help manage active enrollment tokens lifecycle. For security reasons, it's recommended to delete active enrollment tokens as soon as they're not intended to be used anymore.

operation.summary: Creates a migration token, to migrate an existing device from being managed by the EMM's Device Policy Controller (DPC) to being managed by the Android Management API.
operation.description: Creates a migration token, to migrate an existing device from being managed by the EMM's Device Policy Controller (DPC) to being managed by the Android Management API. See the guide (https://developers.google.com/android/management/dpc-migration) for more details.

operation.summary: Lists policies for a given enterprise.

operation.description: Deletes a policy. This operation is only permitted if no devices are currently referencing the policy.

operation.summary: Updates or creates applications in a policy.
Lists web apps for a given enterprise.
Creates a web token to access an embeddable managed Google Play web UI for a given enterprise.
Generates an enterprise upgrade URL to upgrade an existing managed Google Play Accounts enterprise to a managed Google domain.
operation.description: Generates an enterprise upgrade URL to upgrade an existing managed Google Play Accounts enterprise to a managed Google domain. See the guide (https://developers.google.com/android/management/upgrade-an-enterprise) for more details.

operation.summary: Get the device provisioning information by the identifier provided in the sign-in url.
